**What I did:**

- Implemented `app/Dashboard.tsx` as an async Server Component, following the exact pattern already used in `app/page.tsx`: all three `fetch` calls are initiated at once and awaited together with `Promise.all`, so the requests run concurrently instead of waterfalling.
